hooks.command: bash -c 'HB="$HOME/.shiftblame"; [ ! -d "$HB" ] && exit 0; cm() { local r="$1"; git -C "$r" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0; git -C "$r" add -A 2>/dev/null; git -C "$r" diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null && return 0; git -C "$r" commit -m "auto: $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; shopt -s nullglob; for d in "$HB"/*/; do cm "$d"; done; cm "$HB"'
